facts.subject: Amylase pack
facts.statement: Opening one amylase pack gives 100 amylase crystals (enough for 25 stamina potion(4)).
facts.caveat: Wiki flags are main-game; Hardcore Worlds mapping was not checked. Both quotes come from the same wiki page, so this is one source, not two.

sources.title: Amylase pack
sources.quote: |examine = A pack containing 100 crystals of amylase.

facts.subject: Amylase crystal
facts.statement: Amylase crystals are tradeable and exchangeable on the Grand Exchange (item id 12640).
facts.caveat: Wiki flags are main-game; Hardcore Worlds mapping was not checked. The researcher gave released 2014-07-10; the wiki infobox says 3 July 2014, so released here is 2014-07-03 (does not affect the tradeable flag).

facts.subject: Amylase pack
facts.statement: Amylase packs are untradeable, so not on the Grand Exchange. They can only be sold back to Grace's Graceful Clothing for 8 marks of grace.
facts.caveat: Wiki flags are main-game; Hardcore Worlds mapping was not checked. Single wiki page; no second independent source found.

sources.title: Amylase pack
sources.quote: Amylase packs can only be sold back to [[Grace's Graceful Clothing]] for 8 [[marks of grace]]

decisions.decision: All three VERIFIED_WITH_CAVEAT rather than VERIFIED
decisions.reason: Values match exactly on the wiki, but the wiki flags are main-game and no Hardcore Worlds check was possible; the researcher flagged the same gap.

decisions.decision: Corrected released date for C-RFI-402 to 2014-07-03, did not mark DISPUTED
decisions.reason: The disputed field is metadata (researcher said 2014-07-10); the claimed value (tradeable on the GE, id 12640) is unchanged. Recorded in the caveat and researcher_value.

limitations: No second independent source (no Jagex T1 post or price API) was fetched; all three facts rest on one T2 wiki page each.
Hardcore Worlds item/GE mapping not checked.
